visual_enhancers.noise_texture: Subtle SVG noise overlay on backgrounds to prevent flat black look.

grids_layouts.strategy: Asymmetrical, generous whitespace (p-12 to p-32 for sections).
grids_layouts.hero: Asymmetric split or overlapping floating elements. Text intersecting image.
grids_layouts.bento_grid: Used for 'Diferenciais'. Mix of span-1, span-2, row-span-2 items with 1px border-white/10.

motion.hero_reveal: Framer Motion: Masked line-by-line reveal for H1 (overflow-hidden, y: 100% -> 0).
motion.scroll_reveal: Staggered fade-up (y: 40, opacity: 0 -> 1) on scroll using Framer Motion whileInView.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on motorcycle images mapping scrollYProgress to y.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons scale up by 1.02 on hover, glow intensity increases.
motion.scrolling: Lenis smooth scrolling applied at root.

sections.name: Header & Nav
sections.features: Fixed top, glassmorphism backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#121212]/70, logo, 3-4 links, 'Assinar' CTA. Must be sticky.

sections.name: Hero Section
sections.features: Headline: 'PLANO CONQUISTE: a locação que te transforma em dono'. Subheadline. CTAs: [Simular agora] (Cyan filled), [Ver frotas] (Outline). Visual: Premium motorcycle overlapping a dark glowing gradient background. 3D/Parallax effect on bike.

sections.name: Como Funciona (Manifesto)
sections.features: 3 numbered chapters (Escolha -> Aprove -> Receba). Vertical asymmetric layout or huge numbers overlapping text.

sections.name: Diferenciais
sections.features: Bento Grid cards. Icons for: Sem entrada, IPVA/Seguro, Manutenção, Troca flexível, 100% Digital, Cobertura 24h. Hover effects.

sections.name: Frota (Fleet)
sections.features: Filters: Street/Trail/Custom/Premium. Cards showing Honda CG Start, Fan, Bros, Yamaha Factor, Crosser with price 'a partir de'. 'Awwwards' style spotlight lighting in cards.

sections.name: Simulador Dinâmico
sections.features: Interactive UI: Select bike model, drag slider for mileage. Real-time monthly price calculation. Neon cyan active states.

sections.name: Social Proof
sections.features: Testimonial cards with real portraits, 5-star ratings, animated client counter (+1,000 clientes) ticking up via framer-motion.

sections.name: Marquee
sections.features: Editorial slow-moving marquee (react-fast-marquee) with huge outline text or brand keywords.

sections.name: FAQ
sections.features: Modern accordion (Shadcn UI based but customized). 1px border-b, cyan icon rotation on open.

sections.name: Localização
sections.features: Google Maps embed with a dark mode overlay. Floating glass card over map with address, hours, WhatsApp, 'Como chegar'.

sections.name: Final CTA
sections.features: Massive text 'Pronto para pilotar sem preocupações?'. Huge cyan button [Começar agora] with pulse effect.

sections.name: Admin Panel
sections.features: Floating gear icon (bottom right). Opens a Shadcn UI Dialog/Sheet. Tabs: Conteúdo, Cores, Imagens, Contato. Fields update Context/localStorage. 'Export JSON' button.

sections.name: Floating Elements
sections.features: WhatsApp green pulse button #25D366 (bottom right above admin), Back-to-top button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure 'framer-motion' for scroll reveal animations.
Install and configure '@studio-freight/lenis' (or just 'lenis') for smooth momentum scrolling.
Install 'react-fast-marquee' for the editorial scrolling text.
Create the app exclusively using JavaScript (.js/.jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx). Initialize shadcn with js setup.
Implement the dark theme globally in Tailwind config (#121212 background, #00E5FF primary).
Ensure the sticky header has z-50 and uses backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#121212]/70 without a completely transparent background.
Use generous padding (py-24 or py-32) to enforce the Awwwards-level whitespace standard.
Admin panel must read and write to localStorage (e.g., config for content, colors, etc) so the UI reacts to it dynamically. Add a JSON export function.
Apply data-testid to all interactive elements to support UI testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical 'bento' grids or offset flexbox patterns.
Do not use 'transition: all'. Apply transitions selectively (e.g., 'transition-colors transition-transform duration-300 ease-out').
Never center align the root .App container text.
No emojis as icons. Use Lucide icons.
Always use data-testid on buttons, inputs, links, and forms.
Add aria-hidden to purely decorative animations or background text.
If using SVGs, ensure they have proper viewBox and fill='currentColor' or defined strokes.
Ensure minimum WCAG AA contrast ratio. Even with dark mode, #A1A1AA text on #121212 is legible, but pure black backgrounds need off-white text.
All missing images MUST be substituted with provided image_urls, NEVER use placehold.it or dummy text.
